notes.title: NEKO ODYSSEY(STEAM) Releasing Dec16!
notes.content:
How many “likes” will you get on your posts?

Introducing a cozy casual ADV all about taking cat pics,
“Neko Odyssey”(STEAM)!
DEMO content currently available.
Releasing Monday, December 16, 2024!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/0fc4e00fed298b348b103c1b457d8444859153c0.jpg

An update has also been made to the current playable DEMO.
A prologue where players can learn how Miki came to this island - an island with a secret - to live with her Aunt has been added. 
The game is being developed by “SECRET CHARACTER”, a games studio based in Bangkok, Thailand, known for games such as “Yakiniku Simulator” and “Bancho Tactics.”

Drawn with a charming, cozy touch, it shows the protagonist Miki, tired from walking around town, lying down to take a rest when she notices a cat’s tail peeking from the roof and decides to take a photograph of it.


【About the game】
In Neko Odyssey, you get to spend time taking as many pictures as you want of various cats on Cat Island. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/330910066ad79058f7d95f8b39a17ee808a87a4e.gif

The protagonist Miki loves cats. Whenever a cute cat is spotted, take a picture of it on your phone and post it on SNS within the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/7d9bb351903214177b298ee2e17eece7bb05b912.gif

By getting many “Likes” and increasing your follower count, your followers may share some information about other cats you haven’t met before, or give you tips on how to take good pictures.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/bac2e2e91a2567aedc564e7320f3687ac15f9c07.gif

Some cats won’t allow you to take a picture of them unless you gain their trust. Maybe you’ll even notice a secret hidden in the town as you snap pictures around the island.
Join Miki on a heartwarming adventure filled with discoveries, excitement and of course, cuteness!
